templates.example: Fauna retraces the approach to a narrow passage between concrete barriers and finds a way across the boundary into The Swamp.
Following a raised culvert lip, Deaclaw avoids the main approach and crosses into The Center Podium.
Solus takes a longer way around by the narrow rim of a fern bed, arriving in The Mountains away from the main exit.
Hiro takes a longer way around by a row of exposed dark stones, arriving in The Mountains away from the main exit.
Luvy takes a longer way around by a disused quarry ramp, arriving in The Center Podium away from the main exit.
A glint at ankle height stops Akesel in The Swamp. The wire across the trail is left untouched as Akesel goes around it.
Hiro retraces the approach to an old wheel rut through the sand and finds a way across the boundary into The Swamp.
Jokin pauses beside the trail in The Center Podium and eats the sealed rations. The empty wrapper goes back into the pack.
Deaclaw kneels to work a pebble out of a boot. On the exposed edge of a nearby paving stone are three fresh warning scratches.
An unexpected clatter in The Desert makes Joshi retreat without checking the ground. Joshi steps into the drainage shaft and dies in the fall.
In The Tundra, Rick retrieves a sealed arena charge and its matching remote from a closed equipment case.
Kowalik strikes from inside a supply shelter in The Desert as Adur edges through the entrance. The sharpened branch wounds the side. Adur reaches the path before collapsing from fatal blood loss.
An equipment-case lid opens in The Swamp. Joshi checks the contents and claims a hand axe.
An uncovered drain lies behind Shadz in The Swamp. Suggs pelts the path ahead with stones, forcing a retreat. Shadz steps into the shaft and dies in the fall.
Solus finds a machete inside an equipment case in The Mountains and carries it away.
Shield stops in The Center Podium and drinks the remaining clean water from the flask, setting the empty container aside.
The breeze in The Center Podium makes Adur stop and rig the emergency blanket across a low gap. Adur rests behind it, then takes it down.
Hiro searches the equipment cases in The Tundra, choosing a spiked mace to carry away.
A distant cough interrupts the stillness in The Forest. Jokin waits without answering; no second cough comes, and the source remains hidden.
Rick and Adur check the way through a turnstile wedged open with rubble before committing to the crossing into The Swamp.
An equipment case in The Center Podium still holds a spear. AMyriad opens it and takes the weapon away.
Jokin opens an equipment case in The Forest and finds a hunting knife.

Skizzo waits for the weight of Ary to settle on a supply platform in The Mountains before pulling its damaged support. The structure folds inward. Pinned under the fallen decking, Ary dies from the injuries.
The gate is already falling when Hiro draws Rick toward it in The Center Podium. An outstretched foot trips Rick; Hiro rolls clear, leaving the gate to crush the fallen tribute to death.
Inside an equipment case in The Center Podium, Solus discovers a wooden club and takes it.
Jokin stops beside an equipment case in The Center Podium, opens it and claims the crossbow inside.
Waiting low behind a barrier in The Swamp, Hiro strikes at Akesel's knee with a metal rod. Once Akesel falls, Hiro strikes the head. Akesel dies beside the checkpoint.
The search through a case in The Mountains ends with a bow and a quiver of arrows in Skizzo's hands. Skizzo takes the weapon along.

Skizzo corners Hiro at a cache in The Center Podium and stabs the side. Before another blow, Hiro topples the cache into the attacker's path. Clambering over its lid, Hiro escapes alive with a hand over the bleeding wound.
Rick wraps the emergency blanket around his shoulders in The Desert and settles down for the night with it tucked close.
Searching over a barrier in The Forest, Shadz does not see Flurris waiting below. A hard shove tips Shadz onto the broken footing. The head injury proves fatal.

A stab from Shield opens a wound in Solus's thigh beside a supply shelter in The Swamp. Dirt flung at the attacker's eyes buys Solus time to crawl beneath the wall. Solus gets away with the wound still bleeding.
Beside a sorting table in The Center Podium, Emma snaps a length of discarded cord toward Luvy. The cord catches the table leg instead, giving Luvy room to retreat.

The approach is close enough to make misleading tracks valuable. Luvy notices fresh pursuers' tracks near Ary's hiding place in The Mountains. Walking loudly down another path, Luvy draws the search away while Ary stays concealed.

An empty concrete footing is all that remains beyond the turn. Siegfried tells Tobi that a supply shelter lies just beyond a trail bend in The Center Podium. The path ends at an empty concrete footing. When Tobi doubles back, Siegfried is laughing beside the signpost.
Joshi grapples with Jokin between sorting bins in The Center Podium and forces his thigh against a sharp corner. The deep wound keeps bleeding after Jokin breaks free, proving fatal.
Joshi lunges across a low barrier with a metal sliver in The Center Podium. Skizzo kicks the barrier upward into the forearm; the sliver flies into an inaccessible recess as Skizzo backs away.

The resting place has one obvious approach and a less obvious rear. Rick tosses a stone down the trail to draw Hiro away from a resting place in The Tundra, then slips behind the shelter and steals his spiked mace. Hiro returns in time to see who is running off with it.
A shallow runnel leads straight toward Rick's sleeping place in The Forest. Flurris helps scrape a diversion around the hollow so runoff will pass it by.
Suggs invites Tobi to a brief meal in The Center Podium. The rations are shared and finished, earning a grateful nod.
Using a maintenance hatch beneath the podium steps, Siegfried, Adur, Shield and Jokin emerge in The Forest beyond the boundary.

Behind a marker in The Center Podium, Rick waits with a sharpened scrap. The lunge wounds Joshi's shoulder, but Joshi forces Rick back into the marker before escaping behind a bank of earth with the wound still bleeding.
A hidden pit catches Marcos on a trail in The Forest. A broken stake leaves a bleeding thigh wound, but roots along the wall let him climb out alive.
In The Swamp, Deaclaw chases Suggs over a low wall with an exposed metal fitting. Suggs catches the shoulder on its sharp edge; attempts to stop the bleeding fail, and the wound kills her.
Luvy waits behind the central beacon, then swings a broken pipe at Ary. The impact tips Ary through the floor-panel gap. The basement fall kills Ary.
Someone has arranged a water delivery for Kowalik in The Center Podium. No signature identifies the sender; Kowalik collects the water flask from the parcel.
Crouching through a dry channel beneath a tilted platform, Shadz and Emma get clear of the exposed route and into The Desert.
Kowalik accepts a drink from Hiro in The Desert. They split the remaining water and set down the empty flask, grateful for the truce.
The Center Podium landing pulls free of its wall beneath Shield. There is no footing left to catch. Shield falls into the basement and dies.
A sponsor parachute drifts into The Center Podium. Adur opens the food parcel to find sealed rations.
Solus grapples with Marcos between sorting bins in The Forest and forces his side against a sharp corner. The deep wound keeps bleeding after Marcos breaks free, proving fatal.

The safest part of the route is difficult to explain with gestures alone. Shadz draws a route through The Desert in the dirt for Flurris, marking an exposed crossing and a sheltered way around it. Flurris memorizes the turns before they wipe the map away.
Using a maintenance hatch beneath the podium steps, Hiro emerges in The Swamp beyond the boundary.
Shield hears Luvy following through The Center Podium and tosses stones beyond a trail bend. When Luvy turns toward the false footsteps, Shield slips into a drainage hollow and waits out the search.
Siegfried tries to leave the storeroom when generator smoke begins filling it. The swollen door holds fast. The trapped tribute dies from inhaling the smoke.
Deaclaw descends the ruined stairwell in The Center Podium, feeling for each step. A loose tread tips forward, pitching him over the broken edge. Deaclaw dies in the fall.

Footsteps tell Emma that Deaclaw is about to find Kowalik's hiding place in The Center Podium. Emma makes a conspicuous dash down the far trail. Deaclaw follows the decoy, letting Kowalik escape; Emma then loses the chase in cover without injury.
Emma spots familiar fruit on a bush in The Swamp and gathers the ripe berries, eating each handful at the patch.
The announcement sends Marcos out of the Mountains and into The Tundra.
Shield crosses the boundary into The Center Podium and drives a jagged sign bracket into Deaclaw's chest, inflicting a fatal wound.
Akesel catches sight of a crocodile beneath the crossing in The Swamp and retreats onto the high boards. Its lunge reaches only the walkway supports.
Keeping low beside a notch between two split trunks, Rick and Adur pass out of sight of the main trail and into The Center Podium.
Emma takes the warning about the Forest seriously and heads into The Mountains.
Solus climbs a narrow shelf in The Mountains as wolves close in along the trail. Unable to follow, the pack moves on, leaving Solus unharmed.
Cooperation has a simple immediate use: someone might get some sleep. Joshi and Emma agree to keep watch for each other.
The station gate is almost down when Flurris sweeps a foot behind Jokin's ankle. Jokin lands beneath it as Flurris rolls away. The gate's weight kills Jokin.

Fauna chases Shield toward a supply shelter in The Center Podium. Adur pulls Shield through the doorway and braces a fallen beam against the door. While Fauna forces it open, Adur and Shield escape through the rear gap. Nobody is injured.
Akesel takes the warning about the Desert seriously and heads into The Swamp.
Gulliver takes a gully for a shortcut in The Mountains and reaches a sheer wall. Wolves fill the route behind, trapping him. The attack is fatal.

The approach has loose gravel that could betray a footstep. Emma chooses a recess beneath the Center Podium steps, out of sight of the supply lanes. Before resting, Emma checks the nearest exit and scatters loose gravel across the approach.
Keeping low beside a drainage ledge below the supply lanes, Flurris, Skizzo and Suggs pass out of sight of the main trail and into The Swamp.
Rick gives bow and arrows to Jokin without asking for a promise.
Keeping low beside a breach in a low retaining wall, Emma and Shadz pass out of sight of the main trail and into The Center Podium.
Rick and Adur squeeze past a ledge beneath an overhanging slab and reach The Center Podium.
Jokin tests a dark corridor floor with a loose brick, exposing a covered maintenance pit before stepping onto it.
Joshi gathers ripe berries beside the trail in The Swamp and saves the handful in a leaf wrapper.
One equipment drawer has survived the damage around it. Adur pulls signal mirror from a surviving equipment drawer.

Jokin brings branches to a low wall in The Center Podium while Siegfried and Fauna position a fallen sheet against it. Fauna secures the base with stones as Siegfried holds it steady. They close the remaining gaps with branches and rest together beside an unobstructed exit.
The control room monitors offer no useful advice. Skizzo rests in the old control room. Every dead monitor feels judgmental.

The low bank can conceal a small entrance from the trail. AMyriad hears Skizzo searching for cover in The Center Podium and makes room behind a low bank. They conceal the entrance together and sit facing opposite approaches until it feels safe to rest.
Rotten wood hangs above the forest resting place. Solus shelters beneath a dead tree as the forest wind rises. A rotten branch breaks overhead and strikes him; the impact is fatal.
Luvy takes the warning about the Tundra seriously and heads into The Mountains.
Deaclaw packs up after the broadcast and moves from the Swamp into The Center Podium.
The station’s insulation has kept its interior apart from the cold outside. Chaos recovers storm lantern from an insulated weather station.
Siegfried and AMyriad take a longer way around by a row of exposed dark stones, arriving in The Center Podium away from the main exit.
Solus crouches behind a mountain outcrop as a sudden gust tears gravel from the ridge, waiting for a lull before descending.

The bleeding thigh makes this a poor time to keep travelling. Marcos takes cover behind a trail bank in The Forest and tears a strip from a sleeve to bind the earlier thigh wound. The bleeding stops, though every movement still hurts.

Taking turns would give the group of 2 a chance to rest without abandoning the lookout. Chaos and Skizzo agree to take turns keeping watch in The Tundra. Chaos takes the first shift while the other rests, then quietly wakes Skizzo to trade places.
Flurris crosses what looks like leaf-strewn ground in The Forest. The pit beneath gives way, and the fall onto a stake kills him.
The argument offers an excuse more readily than an agreement. Marcos takes sealed arena charge from Hiro in a dispute over the camp rules.

The whiteout hides the next tundra trail marker. Tobi loses the tundra trail in a whiteout and keeps walking instead of digging shelter. Exhaustion forces a stop in the open, and Tobi dies of exposure before the storm clears.
Joshi retraces the approach to a narrow levee through the reeds and finds a way across the boundary into The Center Podium.

A broken seam would leave the approach without support. Emma stamps through the thin snow crust spanning a tundra crevasse, then jumps back as Chaos approaches. The weakened bridge collapses beneath Chaos, whose fall is fatal.
Rick tries to swim the gap beneath a crossing in The Swamp. A crocodile catches him before the far support, and Rick dies underwater.
Tobi descends into a desert service tunnel for shade. Sand pours through the damaged roof and seals the entrance; trapped beneath the collapse, Tobi suffocates.
Fauna notices a floating reed mat drifting away from the swamp bank and steps back onto firm roots before it separates.
Luvy knocks a support from a ruined balcony, but Adur grips a window frame and climbs into the building before the floor falls.
In The Forest, Skizzo steps too close to a boar in the undergrowth. A quick climb onto a fallen tree keeps the tusks out of reach until it moves on.

Marcos drags a frozen branch across the tundra shelter entrance as AMyriad runs inside. AMyriad trips onto the concrete threshold; Marcos slams the heavy shelter door onto his head. The injury is fatal.
Marcos notices a snow shelf bending over the tundra path and crawls away before its outer edge collapses.
Adur crosses the boundary into The Swamp and tips a landing beneath Rick, trapping him between the planks and the bank to drown.
Akesel crosses the boundary into The Forest and jams a sharpened branch through a gap in Siegfried's cover, inflicting a fatal chest wound.

Packed snow provides building material within reach. Skizzo digs a shallow hollow on the sheltered side of a snowbank in The Tundra, packing snow around the edges to keep the wind off while leaving room to crawl out.

The thigh is difficult to bind while guarding every approach. Luvy finds Solus struggling with the earlier thigh wound in The Forest. Keeping watch between knots, Luvy binds it with a strip of cloth until the bleeding stops. Solus accepts the help despite the risk of staying together.
Solus notices fern fronds sagging over a deep forest hollow and probes the ground with a branch before walking around it.
The boots are laced tightly. Adur tries walking more slowly, but the boots squeak with every step.

The leaking tank provides water and a reason to negotiate turns. Skizzo finds Ary crouched beside a leaking supply tank in The Mountains. They take turns catching the water in their hands while the other keeps watch, then agree to leave by different paths.
AMyriad opens the parcel suspended under a sponsor's silver canopy in The Center Podium. Inside is an emergency blanket, which joins the carried supplies.
The apparent snow crossing spans an open ravine. Marcos leaves the marked mountain pass to cross a snow-covered gully. The snow bridge collapses, dropping him into the ravine. Marcos dies on impact.

The boards conceal as much damage as they span. A rotten swamp boardwalk breaks beneath Shadz, trapping a leg between submerged boards. Unable to pull free as the water rises, Shadz drowns. The same channel beneath the boardwalk where Fauna died earlier has now claimed Shadz.

Solus knocks a support from a ruined balcony while Joshi crosses, sending him down with the masonry in a fatal collapse. Shield's earlier death and Joshi's final moments share the same place: the ruined stairwell.

The lake offers a short line toward the shelter. Ary crosses a frozen lake toward a tundra shelter. The ice breaks beneath him; repeated attempts to grip the crumbling edge fail, and Ary drowns. At the frozen lake, Ary has met an end at the very spot where Adur died earlier.
Skizzo enters The Center Podium, meeting Chaos to exchange directions.

The path into camp is less silent than it looks. Joshi creeps toward AMyriad's resting place in The Desert. A line of dry twigs snaps underfoot. AMyriad throws a burning branch from the campfire, forcing Joshi to retreat.

The earlier side injury still needs a dressing. Hiro takes cover behind a trail bank in The Swamp and tears a strip from a sleeve to bind the earlier side wound. The bleeding stops, though every movement still hurts.

The hidden shelter is less secure along its descent. Gulliver climbs beneath a hidden tree shelter and pulls out its ladder pegs. When Suggs starts down, the ladder breaks loose. Suggs falls onto the rocks below and dies.

The deep water leaves no easy place to step aside. Suggs waits at a swamp boardwalk until Chaos steps onto a narrow plank, then rams it sideways with a branch. Chaos falls into the deep channel and drowns beneath the boards.
Pausing at a shallow cutting behind a snow fence to check the ground ahead, Akesel then continues into The Mountains.

The stake is near enough to matter before the path widens. Deaclaw catches Emma at a reed crossing and strikes her with a sharpened stake. Emma reaches the bank but cannot stop the bleeding and dies among the reeds.
A low wall would only need to shield a resting body. Rick builds a shallow windbreak and waits out the gusts.
Pausing at the hard ground around a salt pan to check the ground ahead, Shadz then continues into The Swamp.
A stair landing in the Center Podium gives way beneath Shield. Skizzo drags a fallen door across the gap and steadies it while Shield crawls to the corridor.
The map provides a convenient stopping point before moving on. Suggs sets emergency blanket beside the station map and travels on.

The earlier injury is still bleeding through the pause. Rick takes cover behind a trail bank in The Center Podium and tears a strip from a sleeve to bind the earlier shoulder wound. The bleeding stops, though every movement still hurts.
Jokin hauls up a sloping trunk in The Forest as Fauna approaches. Crossing the branches and dropping behind a fallen tree gives Jokin time to escape.

The arch’s support is visibly worn beside the passage. Solus ducks through a narrow forest gate, then kicks its rotten support as Kowalik follows. The timber arch collapses onto Kowalik, causing fatal injuries.
Hiro kicks a board loose beneath Joshi at the swamp crossing. Joshi catches a support post, hauls onto the next platform, and escapes along the boardwalk while Hiro struggles with the gap.
Loose stones provide material for a low windbreak. Solus chooses a shallow recess below the exposed ridge in The Mountains. Loose stones form a low windbreak, with a gap left open for a quick escape.
The hummocks interrupt a broad stretch of uncertain footing. Shadz tests each hummock before committing any dignity to the mud.
Gulliver crosses the boundary into The Desert and drops a heavy road marker onto Shadz from a low wall; the head injury is fatal.
Mud darkens the edges of the raised ground. Hiro studies a fork beside a leaning survey post and marks a rough route map on the ground.
Rick presses Adur's weapon arm against a barrier in The Swamp and takes the machete. Adur wriggles free and escapes unharmed.
Akesel, Marcos and Suggs all avoid the announced danger and move into The Forest.
In The Tundra, Deaclaw throws a stone along the trail to draw Emma away, then sneaks behind the shelter and takes her spear. Returning, Emma spots Deaclaw running off with it.
Deaclaw tests the footing on a corridor scattered with broken tiles, then chooses a firm place to rest.
Possession of the Whispering Tin has become more complicated than carrying it. Emma hears the Whispering Tin accuse Flurris. Their trust sours and a grudge grows.

Skizzo raises the hand axe in The Tundra, but Adur catches the weapon arm against a barrier and tears it free. Adur strikes Skizzo in the head with the seized hand axe. Skizzo dies from the wound; Adur leaves with the hand axe.

The shelter’s far side keeps the hand axe away from the main view. Rick distracts Luvy with a stone tossed down the trail in The Center Podium, then slips behind the shelter and steals his hand axe. Luvy returns in time to see Rick escaping with it.

The bow and arrows catches against a barrier during a struggle in The Forest. Gulliver forces Solus's grip open and seizes it. Gulliver takes an arrow from the seized quiver and drives its point into Solus's chest. Solus dies from the wound; Gulliver leaves with the bow and arrows.
Siegfried hides a sharpened stake beneath leaves on a forest trail, then rattles a branch to draw Adur forward. Adur falls onto the stake and dies before reaching the path again.
Suggs catches Jokin's weapon arm against a supply barrier in The Swamp and wrests away the wooden club. Jokin breaks free and retreats unharmed; Suggs keeps the weapon.

A supply crate narrows the space between the last two contestants. At the last supply cache in The Tundra, the finalists meet. Luvy ducks behind a supply crate as AMyriad charges, then hooks a foot behind his ankle. AMyriad falls beside the crate; Luvy seizes a sharpened metal fragment and stabs him in the chest. AMyriad dies beside the scattered supplies.

The shrinking arena has made the central cache unavoidable. Solus advances from The Center Podium while Hiro approaches from The Swamp. As the arena closes, they meet at the central supply ground in the Center Podium. Solus ducks behind a supply crate as Hiro charges, then hooks a foot behind his ankle. Hiro falls beside the crate; Solus seizes a sharpened metal fragment and stabs him in the chest. Hiro dies beside the scattered supplies.
Flurris warns Rick away from a wasp nest on the forest trail and guides him around it through the ferns.
Pausing at a row of cut stumps to check the ground ahead, Shield, Gulliver and Suggs then continue into The Swamp.
Adur steadies a loose bridge plank with a boot while Kowalik crawls across the mountain gorge.
Fauna, Siegfried and Luvy check the way through a packed track beside a frozen ditch before committing to the crossing into The Mountains.
There is no settled price for making this right. Suggs apologizes to AMyriad, who listens without promising forgiveness.
With trouble announced, Joshi, Gulliver, Jokin and Suggs head into The Tundra together.
Shield turns the emergency blanket into a low sunshade in The Desert, resting under it before folding it away.
AMyriad follows a clear set of tracks across the boundary into The Swamp.

Tobi advances from The Forest while Jokin approaches from The Center Podium. As the arena closes, they meet at the central supply ground in the Center Podium. Tobi ducks a blow from Jokin and drives a broken tool into his side. Jokin retreats behind a supply barrier but cannot stop the bleeding, dying before the final horn.

The earlier wound has reduced the value of a long escape route. Rick hears Gulliver approaching a trail bank in The Desert. The earlier thigh wound is still bleeding, so Rick cannot risk a chase. A stone thrown down the opposite path draws Gulliver away long enough for Rick to hide.
Rather than rush toward a sound in The Center Podium, Solus waits behind cover until the path is quiet.

The hidden seam breaks the surface below the scratches. Deaclaw spots fresh scrape marks beneath a supply marker in The Center Podium. A concealed compartment holds sealed rations, which Deaclaw pockets before moving on.

In The Swamp, Fauna passes a trail barrier. Deaclaw emerges and swings a machete at Fauna, but the blade catches a post as she ducks. Fauna escapes unharmed while Deaclaw recovers from the missed attack.

The shrinking arena has made the central cache unavoidable. Joshi advances from The Desert while Marcos approaches from The Center Podium. As the arena closes, they meet at the central supply ground in the Center Podium. Joshi ducks behind a supply crate as Marcos charges, then hooks a foot behind his ankle. Marcos falls beside the crate; Joshi seizes a sharpened metal fragment and stabs him in the chest. Marcos dies beside the scattered supplies.

Fresh supplies arrive at the central ground by cargo drone. Rick opens the crate on the Center Podium and packs sealed rations for the road, placing a water flask and an emergency blanket beside the crate for the next visitor.
The Whispering Tin has the appearance of equipment with an extra complication. Luvy acquires Whispering Tin. The lid seems to mutter about the competition.
Chaos finds a pair of boots in a supply crate and pulls them on. The first step squeaks against the ground.
Fauna lifts the Crooked Compass. The needle settles with great confidence on a direction that offers very little safety.
Helping each other out of the scramble, Emma and Shadz reach The Swamp.

Luvy loses footing when Shield trips the approaching tribute beside the central water cache. Shield pushes the heavy tank off its stand. It crushes Luvy to death; Shield takes water flask and an emergency blanket.

Emma is still reaching for the food crate's lid when Suggs pulls a sharpened scrap from within. Suggs stabs Emma in the chest, causing death beside the crate, then takes sealed rations and an emergency blanket.
A loose bar becomes a weapon in Tobi's hands beside the central tools. The strike hits Gulliver in the head and proves fatal. Tobi takes rescue rope and an emergency blanket from the supplies.
Rick and Hiro help each other take the tundra exit into The Tundra.
The spear lies among the equipment at the crowded center. Jokin reaches the Center Podium weapon rack and claims a spear, then backs away from the scramble.
Ary and Hiro get each other clear of the fighting and cross into The Forest.
Skizzo and Deaclaw find an exit together and head into The Mountains.
Skizzo claims a spiked mace from the central weapon rack and moves clear of the opening fight.
AMyriad and Akesel find an exit together and head into The Desert.
Jokin snatches a crossbow from the Center Podium rack and backs clear.
Siegfried takes a wooden club from the Center Podium weapon rack and retreats from the scramble.
The hand axe occupies a small part of the contested weapon rack. Fauna reaches the Center Podium weapon rack and claims a hand axe, then backs away from the scramble.
At the Center Podium weapon rack, Joshi grabs a bow and a quiver of arrows before backing out of the scramble.
The tool rack offers something useful for getting out of trouble. AMyriad chooses rescue rope over a dramatic entrance. Sensible television.
AMyriad, Marcos, Chaos and Suggs choose an early exit and cross into The Tundra.
The central tools include one unusually reflective distraction. Ary pockets signal mirror. The broadcast has acquired a lookout.

The fight at the water rack spills across the open podium. Deaclaw sees Luvy freeze as a fight breaks out at the central water rack. Grabbing his sleeve, Deaclaw pulls him behind a concrete supply barrier before a thrown stone hits the rack.

Announcer: “This is advance notice for anyone planning to remain in the region. The mountains are scheduled for a rockfall tonight. Please descend to the Center Podium before nightfall; the passes will not be reopening.”
Luvy, Skizzo and Ary take the same exit from the bloodbath into The Mountains.
Flurris, Rick and Shadz choose an early exit and cross into The Forest.
Tobi reaches the Center Podium weapon rack and claims a machete, then backs away from the scramble.
Skizzo, Gulliver and Jokin leave the fighting behind and move toward The Swamp.
Kowalik, Joshi and Shield take the tundra exit into The Tundra.

An outstretched arm cuts across the central ration table. Gulliver reaches across the central ration table to grab Skizzo. Skizzo slides underneath it, tips the table toward Gulliver, and crawls clear of the falling supplies.

The ledge leaves little shelter from a fall of rock. Deaclaw takes a narrow mountain ledge beneath an unstable scree slope. Falling stones knock him off the path, and the fall is fatal. Jokin's earlier death and Deaclaw's final moments share the same place: the narrow ledge.

Announcer: “Our location update now concerns the closure in progress. The mountain rockfall is under way. The descending groups are giving us some splendid coverage. Please continue toward the central boundary.”
Announcer: “The mountains are now closed. All return passes are blocked. We look forward to seeing everyone in a slightly smaller setting.”
Siegfried takes a hunting knife from the Center Podium weapon rack and retreats from the scramble.
Unwilling to risk the scramble, Flurris, Solus, Kowalik and Marcos head into The Forest.

Announcer: “Please note the departure deadline in this location update. A controlled burn will begin in the forest tonight. The forest will then leave our available locations. Please use the marked exits before the lighting changes.”

The channel’s green edges disguise a softer center. Siegfried follows a reed channel into deep swamp mud. Each attempt to climb out sinks him farther, until the water closes overhead. Siegfried drowns.
The loudest plans near the supplies do not mention thirst. Shield secures water flask while louder contestants argue about strategy.
Most eyes are on the weapons; the food lies lower down. Jokin slips beneath the fight for the central supplies and claims sealed rations.
Unwilling to risk the scramble, Hiro, Akesel, Gulliver and Siegfried head into The Mountains.

The crates divide the podium into awkward little passages. Solus swings a sharpened scrap at AMyriad over the central supply crates. AMyriad ducks beneath the swing and kicks a loose crate into the path, escaping the attack empty-handed.
A thin reflective packet lies within reach on the supply rack. Jokin grabs emergency blanket, already planning for the first cold night.
Joshi, Chaos, Suggs and Deaclaw leave the opening chaos together and reach The Swamp.
Gravel rolls off the narrow ledge in The Mountains as Luvy steps forward. The weakened edge follows it, dropping him onto the rocks far below. The fall kills him.
Announcer: “The forest burn has started. Those still beneath the canopy should head for the boundary. What wonderful light on the smoke.”
Announcer: “Coverage from this region has reached its scheduled end. The forest is now closed. The fire will continue without further announcements; there is plenty happening elsewhere.”

Announcer: “There is a timed change to the arena’s available destinations. The swamp will be permanently flooded tonight. Please leave by the raised exit before nightfall. We have already moved the camera crew.”
Jokin, Ary and Joshi leave the fighting behind and move toward The Desert.
Chaos leaves the bloodbath for The Forest.
The toppled crate offers a brief gap in the scramble. Adur rescues storm lantern from a toppled supply crate.

Announcer: “A final call for the tundra: please reach the Center Podium before nightfall. Temperatures here will become fatal tonight, and the region will stay closed. We need everyone in position for the next segment.”
Announcer: “We have reached the departure segment for this location. The swamp sluices are open. Anyone still below the raised walkways, this is your exit sequence. We are following several at once.”
Announcer: “The location list has now been shortened accordingly. The swamp is now closed. Its paths are underwater, so please find your next scene in one of our remaining locations.”

Announcer: “There is a timed change to the arena’s available destinations. The desert cooling stations will shut down tonight. Temperatures will make the region uninhabitable. Please return to the Center Podium before nightfall; the remaining locations are ready.”

Announcer: “Our location update now concerns the closure in progress. The desert climate equipment is off. The temperature is rising on schedule. Anyone still out there, do finish your crossing promptly.”
Announcer: “The programme continues elsewhere in the arena. The desert is now closed for the rest of the games. We have narrowed the setting, which should make following your favourites much easier.”

The water checkpoint is not visible from this stretch of desert. AMyriad walks across the desert through the midday heat, searching for a water checkpoint. Disoriented, AMyriad circles the same dune until collapsing. Heatstroke proves fatal before shelter is found.
Announcer: “The remaining exits are now the focus of coverage. The tundra temperature drop has begun. Anyone still making an exit, do keep the pace up. We have a very full evening ahead.”
Announcer: “Please update your choice of destination accordingly. The tundra is now closed for the remainder of the games. A lovely location. On to our remaining attractions.”
Deaclaw discovers rescue rope suspended from an old survey post.
A gap under the ruined hide invites a closer search. Chaos unearths storm lantern beneath a collapsed bird hide.

Adur steps onto a rotten plank in The Swamp. It breaks over the channel beneath the boardwalk, dropping him into the current. Swept beneath the remaining boards, Adur drowns. At the channel beneath the boardwalk, Adur has met an end at the very spot where Shadz died earlier.

Announcer: “A forecast note concerning the desert sandstorm. Desert residents, a sandstorm is due tonight. Please make any necessary introductions before visibility drops. The close-up cameras are ready.”
Flurris crosses what looks like leaf-strewn ground in The Forest. The pit beneath gives way, and the fall onto a stake kills him.

Fauna chases Shield toward a supply shelter in The Center Podium. Adur pulls Shield through the doorway and braces a fallen beam against the door. While Fauna forces it open, Adur and Shield escape through the rear gap. Nobody is injured.
Fauna lifts the Crooked Compass. The needle settles with great confidence on a direction that offers very little safety.

The shrinking arena has made the central cache unavoidable. Solus advances from The Center Podium while Hiro approaches from The Swamp. As the arena closes, they meet at the central supply ground in the Center Podium. Solus ducks behind a supply crate as Hiro charges, then hooks a foot behind his ankle. Hiro falls beside the crate; Solus seizes a sharpened metal fragment and stabs him in the chest. Hiro dies beside the scattered supplies.
